mechanism: Estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of nifedipine, increasing nifedipine plasma concentrations and enhancing vasodilatory effects; nifedipine may increase estradiol levels through competitive CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during initiation or dose changes of either drug; consider nifedipine dose reduction if hypotension or edema develops; counsel on potential for increased side effects.
